Risk Description: Iron Seal proprietary clause creates legal liability and blocks open-source developer adoption
Root Cause: Restrictive custom legal language forbidding redistribution or deployment without explicit enterprise license
Preventive Controls: Establish dual-licensing model (Apache 2.0 / MIT for core UI + Commercial Enterprise for Pro builders)
Mitigation Plan: Update LICENSE file in PR 15; clearly demarcate open-source primitives from proprietary extensions
Monitoring Signals: GitHub community issues, enterprise legal inquiries

Risk Description: Client-side mock authentication creates false sense of security; routes guarded only on frontend
Root Cause: AuthContext stores token in localStorage with no server JWT validation or backend session synchronization
Preventive Controls: Add explicit security warnings in documentation; provide secure backend token exchange hooks
Mitigation Plan: Refactor AuthContext to an abstract adapter pattern; enforce backend authorization headers in PR 16
Monitoring Signals: Penetration test findings, reported security vulnerabilities

Risk Description: Monolithic bundle size (233 kB ESM / 154 kB UMD) due to combined core, components, and DSL
Root Cause: Vite library build packages all 40+ components and parser into a single entry without subpath barrel splitting
Preventive Controls: Configure Vite multi-entry point build with package.json subpath exports (`/button`, `/core`)
Mitigation Plan: Implement chunk splitting and tree-shaking verification in PR 18
Monitoring Signals: Bundle analyzer reports, Lighthouse mobile performance scores

Risk Description: Keyboard focus trapping and ARIA live announcement defects in modal overlays and toasts
Root Cause: Overlays implemented with standard divs lacking comprehensive focus sentinels and aria-live regions
Affected Stakeholders: Assistive Tech Users, QA, Compliance Officers
Preventive Controls: Automated axe-core test suite integrated into CI/CD pipeline
Mitigation Plan: Audit and retrofit Modal, Drawer, Toast, and AlertDialog with focus-trap-react in PR 20
Monitoring Signals: Lighthouse accessibility audit regressions, screen-reader user reports

Risk Description: DSL parser runtime syntax error or unexpected token crashes consuming application
Root Cause: Lexer relies on regex splitting without syntax fault-recovery or detailed line/column error diagnostics
Preventive Controls: Implement try/catch boundary inside `dsl()` with fallback error component rendering
Mitigation Plan: Refactor dslParser to an AST generator with descriptive syntax error nodes in PR 22
Monitoring Signals: Console uncaught error logs, ErrorBoundary catch triggers

Risk Description: Hydration mismatch errors in Next.js / Remix due to immediate `window.matchMedia` and `localStorage` checks
Root Cause: Theme and auth initializers query browser globals at module evaluation time rather than in useEffect
Preventive Controls: Guard all browser globals behind `typeof window !== 'undefined'` and lazy mount states
Mitigation Plan: Standardize SSR hydration guards across ThemeProvider, useLocalStorage, and Router in PR 24

Risk Description: Lack of automated headless browser E2E interaction and visual regression tests
Root Cause: Test suite currently runs in Node.js VM mocking DOM rather than real rendering engines
Preventive Controls: Introduce Playwright test matrix running against Chrome, Firefox, and WebKit
Mitigation Plan: Set up Playwright component tests in CI/CD across core interactive widgets in PR 26
Monitoring Signals: Regression bugs escaping to main branch, visual glitch reports

Risk Description: High dependency on single primary contributor creates maintainability bottleneck
Root Cause: Architecture and core decisions concentrated within original creator without peer review documentation
Preventive Controls: Create comprehensive contributor guidelines, architecture decision records (ADRs), and PR templates
Mitigation Plan: Establish multi-maintainer review board and documented code ownership in PR 28
Monitoring Signals: PR review latency, unanswered GitHub issues

Risk Description: Method chaining API may diverge from standard React JSX prop patterns causing confusion
Root Cause: Dual API paradigm (fluent builder vs declarative JSX) requires maintaining duplicate prop mapping
Preventive Controls: Enforce shared TypeScript interfaces between ComponentProps and Chainable class methods
Mitigation Plan: Unify builder methods to directly generate typed React element props in PR 14 (Verified)
Monitoring Signals: TypeScript compiler discrepancies, API ergonomics complaints

Risk Description: Outdated transitive dependencies or build-time script vulnerabilities
Root Cause: Vite and devDependencies require continuous automated security scanning
Preventive Controls: Integrate npm audit, Snyk, and Dependabot automated checks into CI pipeline
Mitigation Plan: Weekly automated dependency update reviews in PR 30
Monitoring Signals: npm audit vulnerability count, Dependabot security alerts

Risk Description: Drawer and Modal components lack swipe-to-dismiss gesture recognition on touch screens
Root Cause: CSS transitions used without touch event listeners (`onTouchStart`, `onTouchMove`, `onTouchEnd`)
Preventive Controls: Implement touch gesture handlers and velocity threshold calculations
Mitigation Plan: Enhance Drawer component with native swipe physics in PR 50
Monitoring Signals: User experience feedback, touch event drop rates

Risk Description: Excessive re-renders in large declarative Tables and deeply nested Stack layouts
Root Cause: Inline styles and object literals passed into child components without memoization
Preventive Controls: Implement React.memo, useMemo, and virtualized rows for tables exceeding 100 items
Mitigation Plan: Add virtual scrolling support to Table and optimize render loops in PR 58
Monitoring Signals: React Profiler flame charts, FPS frame drops during table sorting
